normal.name: Dirk
normal.text: I think I will take advantage of the upcoming long weekend and get into #20Strong. I don't know how the design process worked between #AwakenRealms and #ChipTheoryGames, but I've gone through the manuals for #Etherfields and #Nemesis, and I like how they brought aspects of each original game into 20 Strong: As for Nemesis: "20 Strong is a solo game, but we're introducing 2- and 3-player semi-cooperative rules!" And Etherfields: "We're doing persistency between games. Changes made in one game carry over to the next!" #boardgames #gamenight

normal.name: neongod
normal.text: Finally had some time to open the Game Gear up. It’s a VA1 and it looks like there is no capacitor leak damage, at least for the first glance, which is good. I think it was recapped some time ago, but the work doesn’t look particularly nice. I ordered an SMD capacitor kit, will see if I can do a nicer job. Also, the volume seems too loud even on the lowest setting, and I’m not sure yet why is that. Maybe the potmeter needs a replacement. #retrogaming #sega #gamegear
